addr: Flyover, 330/9, 2nd A Main, 100 Feet Rd, near Indiranagar, Domlur, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560071, India

rev.t: A fantastic bookstore with a wide and diverse collection spread across two spacious floors. One of the best places in Bangalore for book lovers! You'll find books of all genres — fiction, non-fiction, academic, children’s books, and more. Whether you're a casual reader or a serious collector, this place is worth a visit

They’ve got a great collection of books and also a nice place to buy stationery and other knick knacks. The vibe is chill, and the staff is super friendly, so you can browse without any interruptions. …
Every small detail requirement gets fulfilled here. Even go for window shopping then also you will buy something before coming out. Varieties and distinct items are sold in the ground floor. …
